content.value: A plugin-dynamic command-line client that builds its own command tree from the server's Capabilities Manifest.
is a Go command-line tool — the non-interactive face of the same binary that also runs the Go TUI (repo root +
). It reads and writes production Barkpark over HTTP API v1, authenticated via Auth and Tokens. It is one of the Surfaces, built for scripts, CI, and humans who live in a shell.
is that its commands are not hard-coded. On startup it fetches
— the Capabilities Manifest — and assembles its verb tree from what the server reports. When a new plugin ships on the server and advertises commands in the manifest, those verbs appear in
automatically, no client release required. This is why
can front every Plugins surface without bespoke wiring.
, and friends drive the claim queue. Other manifest-derived verbs reach into a Document, run a Mutation, or trigger a Search against the Postgres Search backend.

Both reads and writes go straight at the live server; there is no local store. A write becomes a Mutation over HTTP API v1, subject to the same Schema v2 validation and Webhooks fan-out as any other client.
